paragraphs: Ages 2-3 chew one gummy as needed at bedtime. Ages 4 and up chew two gummies as needed at bedtime.

paragraphs: Use only as directed. Consult the child's physician before use if they have a serious medical condition or use prescription medications. This product may cause drowsiness.
Keep out of reach of children. Do not use if safety seal is damaged or missing. Store in a cool, dry place.
